description: The objective-6 benchmark: five independent asynchronous master clocks, one generated (divided) clock per master at four distinct ratios, clock-domain crossings between all five, an FSM, and ~50K standard cells on nangate45. Each of the five domains carries one deliberate structural bottleneck that RTL can fix without changing latency.

known_bottlenecks: sys: serial accumulate chain over 12 unpipelined 16x16 multipliers, with the 40-bit saturation compare at the end of the chain rather than beside it
dsp: 12-tap correlator whose products are summed serially instead of in a tree
io: 64-way priority select written as a serial mux cascade, so bit 63 waits on all 63 below it
mem: 32-entry CAM where the hit index is resolved by a serial priority cascade over the match vector
aux: 256-bit parity written as a serial XOR chain (depth 256 instead of 8), and a bit-serial CRC32 update
notes.invariants: rewrites must preserve each domain's latency exactly and be bit-exact. The five datapaths share no signal and may be rewritten independently.
notes.cdc_off_limits: every identifier prefixed cdc_, plus the clock dividers (clk_*_div*_r). The per-domain equivalence proof cuts these boundaries, so a change here is invisible to SEC — see docs/equivalence-contract.md. None of it is on a critical path.
notes.generated_clock_pins: The 'port' field of each generated clock is the post-synthesis instance pin of its divider flop, which yosys `autoname` names <net>_<CELL>_<PIN>. That name is stable only while the divider RTL is unchanged — which it is, because the dividers are in the do-not-edit region above. If synthesis ever renames them the SDC fails loudly (OpenSTA 'pin not found', not a silent mis-analysis); recover with: astra syn soc_bench && grep -oE 'DFFR_X1 [a-z_]*div[0-9]_r[A-Za-z0-9_]*' runs/soc_bench/<run>/01_synth/netlist.v
notes.purpose: objective 6. Also the first design in this repo with more than one clock, so it is what exercises the multi-clock data model end to end, and the first with a state machine, which objective 3's FSM half had no testbed for.
